name: economics
notes: Economic pin (issue #11): declared market-average tariffs, not measured; sensitivity scales all prices together (±x2 / x0.5). p_att is a scenario constant of the real-shop attacker share (lab mix w_A=0.5 is internal and never fed to the queue model directly). C_churn and p_att are consumed by the queue model (#12).

queue.notes: Scale anchor (issue #12, canon dvarp#39): at least 30% of all shop requests go straight to the human queue (customers demanding a human, independent of defense) — this flow creates the baseline operator load rho0 = 0.3 at the anchor. The AI agent handles the remaining (1-h)/h times larger flow; escalations come only from the AI channel, reweighted by p_att. Patience doubles as the SLA threshold. Erlang C, no simulation.
